general: Jungle guide. Xin Zhao is an early-game jungler who wants tempo, not long full clears: start Red Buff and either go for a level 2 cheese gank on the most punishable lane or invade if you know you win the 1v1 (only with lane priority and lanes that can follow). The standard route is Red, Krugs, Blue for a fast level 3, then gank, invade or take one more camp before contesting scuttle. Combos are E into Q (auto until the knock-up lands), E-Q-W, and the full E-Q-W-R engage. When ahead, convert through Rift Herald and early solo dragons and control both rivers, since he wins most early jungle duels. His strongest window is mid game, forcing fights and using R to knock carries into your team, so try to end before late game, when he falls off and plays a more front-to-back peel role.
